summary.en: Attempted Murder or Accident? (Past) Location: Tiger Trading building parking lot Victim: Torazo Fukamachi Time: A few days ago Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Torahiko Fukamachi After an injury to the knee three years ago, Torazo decided to walk in the parking lot to train himself everyday as part of his rehabilitation but a few days ago, he tripped and fell on the parking block which injured him. He is then still unconscious at the hospital and people suspect it to be in fact attempted murder. Location: Tiger Trading building, parking lot, warehouse and Kiriyama's house Victim: Eisaku Kiriyama Time: Three days ago Suspects: Torahiko Fukamachi Kiriyama had received life-threathening messages on a wall of his office while his boss was still unconscious. It is the driver Ukaji who found them.
